review:
Merge Up on a 6x6 grid of lucky numbers. Winning clusters pay and merge into higher numbers, and BGaming built the base game to be the exciting part – not just a wait for the bonus.

In free spins, every win marks cells with growing multipliers, and symbols around the biggest ones spin to build the tension. Very high volatility, 5,000x max and an excellent 97.25% RTP. Free spins about once every 276 spins. Basically Merge Up with an Asian lucky-numbers theme.
pros: Excellent 97.25% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
